notes: Workspace approach failed (2 ts-mls instances due to @noble/ciphers peer resolution difference). Pack+tarball approach used instead — no devDeps in tarball means exactly one ts-mls. Verified locally: pnpm why ts-mls shows 1 version, tsc --noEmit passes with zero errors.

retrospective.finding: pnpm creates separate virtual packages for the same ts-mls version when its transitive peer deps (@noble/ciphers) resolve differently across contexts. Using workspace:* with devDeps present in the source tree causes this. The pack+tarball approach sidesteps it because devDeps are excluded from tarballs.
